entities.name: Westvale Abbey
entities.description: A cathedral in the village of Westvale in Gavony, once a sanctuary and now a corrupted stronghold of Ormendahl and site of Skirsdag worship.

entities.name: Westvale
entities.description: Village in the Moorland parish of Gavony.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: Demon released from the shattered Helvault who made the abbey his lair.

entities.name: Skirsdag cult
entities.description: Cult that repurposed the abbey for demonic rites and worships Ormendahl.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: Church whose oversight the abbey's remoteness avoided.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: Order whose oversight the abbey's remoteness avoided.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison from which Ormendahl was released when it shattered.

events.summary: After Ormendahl's release from the shattered Helvault, the Skirsdag cult repurposes the abbey for demonic rites.
events.quote: the Skirsdag cult repurposed the abbey as a site for demonic rites

events.summary: With Ormendahl's emergence the abbey is violently transformed into a profane monument and the demon's lair.
events.quote: The sacred structure was twisted into a profane monument

relations.note: fully dedicated the abbey to his worship
relations.quote: the cult fully dedicated the site to his worship
within the Moorland parish of Gavony on the plane of Innistrad
